name: Zephyr Stable Dollar
oneLiner: ZSD is Zephyr Protocol's dollar stablecoin on a Monero-derived private chain, minted from ZEPH base-coin collateral through a Djed-inspired reserve mechanism.
collateral: ZEPH base-coin collateral held by the Zephyr Protocol reserve; the protocol targets overcollateralization before allowing new ZSD minting
pegMechanism: Users mint or redeem ZSD against ZEPH through Zephyr's Djed-inspired reserve mechanism, with oracle pricing and reserve-ratio constraints maintaining the dollar target

oracleRisk.summary: Zephyr documents ZSD as a Djed-style stablecoin backed by one protocol-wide ZEPH reserve with a 400% minimum reserve ratio; current public materials do not identify the production oracle provider set or failure handling.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research
branchApplicability.rationale: Zephyr describes ZSD as a protocol reserve liability backed by ZEPH, with minting gated by a system-wide reserve ratio. Users do not open borrower-specific collateral positions, so the reviewed design exposes no market-specific collateral or liquidation branches to inventory.

sources.label: Zephyr v2.3.0 wallet and daemon control source

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Reviewed on 2026-07-15 against official Zephyr v2.3.0 source commit 67c5f53 and native-chain Explorer state. ZSD is a native Zephyr asset, not an issuer-deployed production EVM token. Same-asset ZSD sends map to STABLE_TRANSFER; the reviewed consensus paths expose no address blacklist, holder freeze, seize, privileged burn, or current issuer/admin transfer-pause path. Wallet-RPC freeze marks only a locally held transfer/key image in that wallet's m_transfers state, while daemon set_bans concerns P2P hosts or subnets. At height 819289, block 386f59b9b27984fc4d476d89e1142f0b3189987e2da245eace0268e5fe50cc19, the network was at HF11 and the official reserve snapshot corroborated that height. The 2025 audit hardfork previously restricted normal network transactions and invalidated legacy asset types, but this was a historical consensus-wide migration rather than a current account-targeted issuer control. No direct blacklistability established.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 access review

mintAuthority.summary: ZSD is minted and redeemed through Zephyr's native reserve-ratio protocol rules against ZEPH collateral. Source code review confirms no admin/emergency mint path: all transaction_type enum values (MINT_STABLE, MINT_RESERVE, MINT_YIELD) are user-facing; blockchain.cpp contains no admin override. The Zephyr foundation controls the oracle RSA signing key (cryptonote_config.h), a price-feed centralization vector, but not a privileged mint bypass.

controls.label: Zephyr native reserve mint/redeem rules
controls.capDescription: Minting depends on native reserve-ratio and oracle rules in protocol consensus; no EVM-style privileged minter exists.
controls.evidence: Source review of enums.h confirmed transaction_type enum lists only user-facing types (MINT_STABLE, REDEEM_STABLE, MINT_RESERVE, REDEEM_RESERVE, MINT_YIELD, REDEEM_YIELD, TRANSFER variants, AUDIT types) — no ADMIN_MINT or emergency bypass type. blockchain.cpp contains no 'admin', 'foundation', 'emergency', or 'bypass' patterns. cryptonote_config.h includes a hardcoded foundation oracle RSA key (ORACLE_PUBLIC_KEY), which controls price-feed signing but is not a direct mint authority. 2026-07-20 follow-up: failure domain anchored to the Zephyr base protocol itself; there is no privileged contract or account with mint authority — mint/redeem is open to any user against ZEPH collateral under deterministic reserve-ratio rules.

sources.label: Zephyr GitHub - native mint transaction types

review.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-07-20. Official Zephyr source exposes only reserve-ratio-gated user MINT_STABLE, MINT_RESERVE, and MINT_YIELD transaction types; no admin, emergency, or foundation mint bypass was found in enums.h, blockchain.cpp, or cryptonote_tx_utils.cpp. Existing ZSD rules therefore enforce collateral and reserve-ratio checks continuously as part of each mint, and the existing asset's native consensus rules cannot be upgraded through a privileged contract or account. The foundation oracle RSA key is a price-feed centralization vector, not a direct mint authority. No named prudential supervisor is evidenced by the reviewed protocol materials.

reserves.name: ZEPH protocol reserve
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Zephyr Protocol on-chain reserve (ZEPH base coin)

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-5 (lead ylds-figure)
reserveReview.rationale: Zephyr's Djed-inspired design holds a single-asset reserve: ZSD is minted and redeemed only against ZEPH, so the complete reserve composition is 100% ZEPH held by the protocol. The live reserve-snapshot API captured 2026-07-20T20:12Z reports 4,449,790.59 ZEPH in reserve against 422,015.37 ZSD in circulation (reserve ratio 447.5%). The slice is named to match the live zephyr-scanner reserve-adapter identity so the reviewed classification overlays the captured exposure.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Zephyr Protocol single-asset reserve design and live reserve-snapshot API
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The reserve is a single on-chain ZEPH position by protocol design; no other reserve asset exists. ZEPH market depth and the reserve-ratio health of the mechanism are tracked separately from composition.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: ZEPH is Zephyr Protocol's native base coin held as exogenous crypto collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.

providers.name: Zephyr Protocol on-chain reserve (protocol consensus custody)

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-5 (lead ylds-figure)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: The ZEPH reserve is locked in the protocol's on-chain reserve address under consensus rules rather than with a legal custodian; legal segregation, insolvency treatment, and reuse restrictions are not applicable constructs the reviewed sources establish. Reserve balances are publicly verifiable through the snapshot API.

notices.title: Unsupported private chain
notices.message: ZSD primarily circulates as a native Zephyr asset on a Monero-derived chain, which is not a configured Pharos chain, so no contract is stored.
